message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: "2015年2月至3月期间，被告人盛某先后四次在其登记入住的宾馆或酒店房间内容留他人以自制冰壶烫吸方式吸食甲基苯丙胺（冰毒）。"

So the defendant used hotel rooms to allow others to smoke meth (crystal meth). The crime likely is "非法持有、使用毒品" or "吸食毒品" but the person is providing location for others to use. In Chinese criminal law, providing a place for drug consumption is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Also the act of using drug himself is "吸食毒品罪". The fact says "留他人以自制冰壶烫吸方式吸食甲基苯丙胺". It says "留他人" meaning "allow others" to use. So the crime is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Also possibly "非法持有、使用毒品罪" if he possessed. But the fact only mentions he allowed others to use. So we list "容留他人吸食毒品罪". The Chinese legal term: "容留他人吸食毒品罪". So answer: [罪名]容留他人吸食毒品罪<eoa>
